0.0: Bleh, humans drink this tea? It's disgusting! A fairy with tastes as refined as mine can't possibly drink tea made of #t4000331#. You over there, bring me some #b#t4031577##k.

yes.0: A gaggle of simple humans were on the way to #p2012012# in #m200000000# with #b#t4031577##k, but lost it in #b#m260010700##k. Those #bDesert Rabbits#k have my tea leaves, and I want them back! Find it!\r\nGet going now and stop pestering me. I don't care how you find it, FIND IT.

no.0: You dare disobey a queen? Insolence! Don't you dare think that you'll be safe here in #m260000000#!

1.0: Did you bring the #t4031577#? Ho, this is a #t4031577#, indeed. The scent of this leaf is amazing compared to #t4000331#. This should be sufficient.

yes.0: Not bad for a commoner. That's not saying much, since you're not a fairy, after all...

item.0: You still haven't found my #b#t4031577##k? I knew humans are worthless... Just beat up Desert Rabbits until you find it!

lost.0: You lost the #t4031577# after all my warnings? I shouldn't give you this for free, but since there's a fairy waiting for it, I'll give you another one. Just this once. Please take this and return to #m260000000#.

QuestInfo.name: The Queen's Tea
QuestInfo.0: The famously opulent queen of #b#m260000000##k also has picky tastes. Talk to #b#p2101007##k.
QuestInfo.1: Queen #p2101007# is not satisfied with the sublime tea made from #t4000331#. Seriously? After a lot of complaining she wants you to find #b#t4031577##k to make even fancier tea from. \r\n\r\nFind #b#t4031577##k on the Desert Rabbits in #m260010700#.
QuestInfo.2: As expected, the queen didn't even say thanks. You can understand why the people of #m260000000# hate her guts. Arrrgh!
